evidence.title: 涵秋馆 and 仙人承露台: park page
evidence.summary: A north-south island, lake east and north, facing 凤麟洲 to the east, planted for autumn colour. The hall stands in the north: south-facing double 工-plan, front and rear halls of seven bays with galleries, rockwork fountain between, fed by a raised tank east of the wall. A five-bay covered bridge to the west. East of the hill, 仙人承露台: bronze figure with a dew plate on a rock terrace, figure lost; round stone base now in 中山公园; 1989 stone copy. Site bars reuse: facts only.

evidence.title: 老北京的记忆(79): 绮春园涵秋馆与生冬室, quoting 百景图志
evidence.summary: 涵秋馆 about 1805, added 1810: a seven-bay double 工字 hall with a rockwork fountain between the halls, fed by a raised tank east. 仙人承露台 Xianren Chenglu Tai, a bronze immortal on a high platform, stands near; its base now sits in 中山公园. 生冬室 was 明善堂, then 含淳堂: seven bays with an indoor stage. Today's platform hides 涵秋馆's base.

evidence.title: 仙人承露台须弥座
evidence.summary: Built under Jiaqing, east of the rockery of 涵秋馆, on the west shore of the 凤麟洲 lake. The bronze figure is lost; the park made a black stone copy in 1989. Do not model the copy as period form.

evidence.title: 圆明园凤麟洲保护工程考古勘探报告
evidence.summary: Survey by 北京市文物研究所, June-July 2007. East of 仙人承露台, water on all sides, stone-edged. Area A about 50 by 26-48 m, 1690 m2; area B 24 by 22 m, 445 m2. Later layers are paywalled.

evidence.title: 圆明园涵秋馆保护工程考古勘探报告
evidence.summary: Survey 2007, west of 仙人承露台: about 55-74 by 26-48 m, 2586 m2. The intro of the free part names 曲苑风荷 by a slip; title and tags give 涵秋馆.
